datasets.citation: Smith et al. (2013), U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 801
datasets.license: Public domain U.S. Government work; metadata states no access constraints and a fitness-for-use disclaimer.
scientific_limits: Low-density survey of the conterminous United States, not global coverage.
Selected elements use different analytical methods and digestion or fusion procedures.
The 0-5 cm table is one soil depth only.
datasets.title: Geochemical and Mineralogical Data for Soils of the Conterminous United States

datasets.citation: Bailey et al. (2000), U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report 99-433, version 2.0
datasets.license: Metadata access constraints: none; use constraints: none; supplied as-is with a fitness-for-use disclaimer.
scientific_limits: Legacy analyses span the mid-1960s to late 1980s and method accuracy varies.
N, L, G, H and B qualifiers have distinct meanings and must not be treated as numbers.
Coordinates are NAD27 and location accuracy varies with the source map.
datasets.title: U.S. Geological Survey RASS Geochemical Data for Alaska: Circle quadrangle stream sediments

datasets.citation: Bailey et al. (2007, revised 2010), U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report 2007-1196 version 1.1
datasets.license: Metadata access constraints: none; use constraints: none; supplied with a fitness-for-use disclaimer.
scientific_limits: Only 59 reconnaissance rock samples from one Alaska quadrangle; not regional or global coverage.
Coordinates are NAD27 and published horizontal accuracy is approximately 20 feet.
Rock formation, lithology and age are field observations with blanks and question marks where uncertain.
datasets.title: Major and trace element data for rock samples collected in the Taylor Mountains quadrangle, Alaska

datasets.citation: Water Quality Portal, accessed 2026-08-05 using the frozen query, DOI 10.5066/P9QRKUVJ
datasets.license: Publicly available USGS/NWIS observations; cite the WQP DOI and exact query.
datasets.publisher: National Water Quality Monitoring Council / USGS / EPA
scientific_limits: One monitoring location and one analyte; not representative of regional or global water quality.
The portal is dynamic, so the frozen file hash is the reproducible test artifact.
Many historical results omit the analytical method.
datasets.title: Water Quality Portal arsenic results for USGS-01594440

scientific_scope: Offline, independently verifiable real-data holdout for D2; not a claim of global coverage.
